dimensions.note: Found and fixed: `.optional()` hid `sensitive: true` from the secret field's outer schema (published 2026.09.30.1 exposes it there); now set on both sides, with a test. secretRef values are registered with context.redactor as soon as they are read and never written or logged; the e2e run and unit test check that neither output nor datastore holds the vault-read value. Unresolved detail carries vault/key addresses and the vault's lookup error only, capped at 300 chars. Inline literals are still echoed in run output, same as 2026.09.30.1 (swamp redacts vault-sourced values only); the docs say never to inline.

Found and fixed: there was no log on method entry, and an unresolved secret logged at info. The method now logs `Auditing {total} credentials` on entry, a per-credential info line, a warn line for `unresolved` (id plus detail, no value), and a completion summary. All logging uses structured placeholders.

resolveSecret's try/catch is deliberately broad and scoped to one vault read: the defect being fixed is that one failed read killed the run. A failure becomes a per-entry `unresolved` finding with an actionable detail. Config problems (preflight, schema refine: exactly one of secret/secretRef) still throw before any write.

84 tests. The audit test uses createModelTestContext (swamp-testing 0.20261016.58) with a fake vault service: a missing ref, an empty read, no vault service, a long error, the schema refine, outer sensitive meta, the reserved instance name, and body release on every non-2xx probe path. Negative control: reverting the meta and github fixes fails 2 tests. Real swamp e2e against a local_encryption vault: succeeded with 3 total, 2 ok, 1 unresolved; the inline vault.get() form of the same config fails the run (exit 1).
Read-only. Each run overwrites the same instances; an interrupted run leaves earlier instances in place, and the summary is written last.

Probe HTTP contracts are unchanged from 2026.09.30.1. Responses are shape-checked before field access (non-JSON or missing fields return unreachable). b2_list_keys is a targeted lookup (startApplicationKeyId, maxKeyCount=1), so it needs no pagination. One request per credential per day, so there is no rate-limit exposure.

Found and fixed: github-pat (every path), gitlab-pat, pve-token and b2-key (authorize and list_keys) returned on non-2xx without reading or cancelling the response body, holding a connection until GC. All now call body.cancel(), as scaleway-key already did. A test covers each path; reverting github fails it.
README examples and test fixtures use placeholder names (store, testvault, SCWEXAMPLEKEY0000001, example.com). The pre-push denylist hook passed on both commits.
Plain z.object with no passthrough. The secretRef object is strict, and the refine enforces exactly one of secret/secretRef.
Both specs have lifetime infinite and garbageCollection 30 (unchanged).
A single read-only audit method by design: no lifecycle resource to create, update or delete.
Nothing mutates. The configuration preflight (duplicate ids, normalisation clashes, and now ids that normalise to the reserved `current`) refuses the run before any write.

Found and fixed: a credential id normalising to `current` would collide with the audit summary instance and be overwritten by it. preflight now refuses such an id (AUDIT_INSTANCE constant, with a test).
The method never reads back stored state.
Model 2026.10.20.1 adds an upgrades entry (no-op: secretRef is optional, secret unchanged, and the new audit count is additive).
